full_judgment:
Syed Md. Ziaul Karim, J: By this appeal, the informant-appellant has challenged the legality and propriety of the order of dated 31-10-2002 passed by learned Judge of Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Tribunal no.2, Dhaka (briefly as Tribunal), releasing accused-respondent no. 2 on bail, in Uttara Case no. 32(10)2002 corresponding to G.R. no. 2082 of 2002 under Sections 7, 30 of the Nari-O-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000( briefly as Ain, 2000) by Criminal Case no. 518 of 2002. 

 2. Facts in brief are that on 23-01-2002 the informant Md. Iqbal Shajjad, lodged a first information report with Uttara P.S. accusing accused respondent along with two others namely Kamrul Islam and Bicu Shikder alleging that on 28-06-2002 at 6.30 p.m. all the accused abducted her minor daughter Banazir Sajjad aged about fifteen years from the road north of Uttara High School. His daughter was a student of O' level at BIT Uttara School. Thereafter the accused James forcibly took the victim to America from there, they again came back to Bangladesh. With these allegations the informant lodged the instant case. 

 4. Eventually, he was granted bail by the Tribunal in Criminal Misc. Case no. 518 of 2002 by the impugned order.
